bash -lc cat > /mnt/data/figure_work/build_figures.py <<'PY'
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE, MSO_CONNECTOR
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR, MSO_AUTO_SIZE
from pptx.enum.dml import MSO_LINE_DASH_STYLE
from pathlib import Path
import math

src=Path('/mnt/data/runtime_story_editable')
out=Path('/mnt/data/stick_figure_editorial');out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
INK=RGBColor(29,30,31); MUTED=RGBColor(104,104,103); YEL=RGBColor(255,215,46); PAL=RGBColor(255,246,205); PALE=RGBColor(246,245,241); WHITE=RGBColor(255,255,255)

class Draw:
 def __init__(self,s,dx=4.75,dy=2.38): self.s=s;self.dx=dx;self.dy=dy
 def conv(self,x,y):return Inches(self.dx+x), Inches(self.dy+y)
 def line(self,x1,y1,x2,y2,c=INK,w=2.25,dashed=False):
  sh=self.s.shapes.add_connector(MSO_CONNECTOR.STRAIGHT,*self.conv(x1,y1),*self.conv(x2,y2));sh.line.color.rgb=c;sh.line.width=Pt(w)
  if dashed: sh.line.dash_style=MSO_LINE_DASH_STYLE.DASH
  return sh
 def rect(self,x,y,w,h,fill=None,stroke=INK,sw=1.6,radius=False):
  sh=self.s.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE if radius else MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE,*self.conv(x,y), Inches(w), Inches(h))
  sh.fill.solid();sh.fill.fore_color.rgb=(fill if fill else WHITE)
  if stroke is None:sh.line.fill.background()
  else:sh.line.color.rgb=stroke;sh.line.width=Pt(sw)
  if radius:
   try:sh.adjustments[0]=0.10
   except:pass
  return sh
 def oval(self,x,y,w,h,fill=None,stroke=INK,sw=2):
  sh=self.s.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.OVAL,*self.conv(x,y), Inches(w),Inches(h))
  sh.fill.solid();sh.fill.fore_color.rgb=fill if fill else WHITE
  if stroke is None:sh.line.fill.background()
  else:sh.line.color.rgb=stroke;sh.line.width=Pt(sw)
  return sh
 def txt(self,txt,x,y,w,h,font=11,bold=True,c=INK,align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER):
  sh=self.s.shapes.add_textbox(*self.conv(x,y),Inches(w), Inches(h))
  tf=sh.text_frame;tf.clear();tf.margin_left=Inches(.01);tf.margin_right=Inches(.01);tf.margin_top=0;tf.margin_bottom=0
  pp=tf.paragraphs[0];pp.text=txt;pp.alignment=align
  for run in pp.runs:run.font.name='Arial';run.font.size=Pt(font);run.font.bold=bold;run.font.color.rgb=c
  return sh
 def person(self,cx,cy,s=1,pose='normal',yellow=False):
  # cx head center; cy head top
  h=.35*s; self.oval(cx-h/2,cy,h,h,fill=PAL if yellow else WHITE,sw=2.5)
  n=cy+h; hip=cy+.99*s; self.line(cx,n,cx,hip,w=2.8)
  if pose=='reach':
   self.line(cx,n+.20*s,cx+.45*s,n-.1*s,w=2.5);self.line(cx,n+.20*s,cx-.3*s,n+.42*s,w=2.5)
  elif pose=='shock':
   self.line(cx,n+.18*s,cx+.33*s,n-.28*s,w=2.5);self.line(cx,n+.18*s,cx-.33*s,n-.28*s,w=2.5)
  elif pose=='tired':
   self.line(cx,n+.21*s,cx+.27*s,n+.39*s,w=2.5);self.line(cx,n+.21*s,cx-.32*s,n+.32*s,w=2.5)
   self.line(cx+.27*s,n+.39*s,cx+.15*s,cy+.22*s,w=2.5)
  elif pose=='run':
   self.line(cx,n+.19*s,cx+.39*s,n+.01*s,w=2.5);self.line(cx,n+.19*s,cx-.3*s,n+.42*s,w=2.5)
  else:
   self.line(cx,n+.20*s,cx+.32*s,n+.40*s,w=2.5);self.line(cx,n+.20*s,cx-.32*s,n+.40*s,w=2.5)
  if pose=='run':
   self.line(cx,hip,cx+.37*s,hip+.3*s,w=2.5);self.line(cx,hip,cx-.31*s,hip+.31*s,w=2.5)
  else:
   self.line(cx,hip,cx-.28*s,hip+.39*s,w=2.5);self.line(cx,hip,cx+.28*s,hip+.39*s,w=2.5)
 def robot(self,cx,cy,s=1,pose='normal'):
  w=.43*s;h=.39*s
  self.rect(cx-w/2,cy,w,h,fill=PAL,stroke=INK,sw=2.4,radius=True)
  self.oval(cx-.12*s,cy+.15*s,.052*s,.052*s,fill=INK,stroke=None)
  self.oval(cx+.075*s,cy+.15*s,.052*s,.052*s,fill=INK,stroke=None)
  self.line(cx,cy,cx,cy-.11*s,w=2)
  self.oval(cx-.045*s,cy-.16*s,.09*s,.07*s,fill=YEL,stroke=INK,sw=1)
  n=cy+h;hip=cy+1.02*s
  self.line(cx,n,cx,hip,w=2.9)
  if pose=='edit':
   self.line(cx,n+.18*s,cx-.32*s,n+.44*s,w=2.6)
   self.line(cx,n+.18*s,cx+.39*s,n+.03*s,w=2.6)
  elif pose=='build':
   self.line(cx,n+.18*s,cx+.34*s,n-.16*s,w=2.6)
   self.line(cx,n+.18*s,cx-.35*s,n+.38*s,w=2.6)
  else:
   self.line(cx,n+.18*s,cx+.31*s,n+.39*s,w=2.6)
   self.line(cx,n+.18*s,cx-.31*s,n+.39*s,w=2.6)
  self.line(cx,hip,cx-.27*s,hip+.39*s,w=2.6)
  self.line(cx,hip,cx+.27*s,hip+.39*s,w=2.6)
 def arrow(self,x1,y1,x2,y2,c=INK):
  self.line(x1,y1,x2,y2,c=c,w=2.2)
  a=math.atan2(y2-y1,x2-x1);d=.14
  for t in (a+2.55,a-2.55):self.line(x2,y2,x2+d*math.cos(t),y2+d*math.sin(t),c=c,w=2.2)
 def spark(self,x,y,s=1):
  for a in range(0,360,45):
   r1=.17*s;r2=.31*s;ang=math.radians(a)
   self.line(x+r1*math.cos(ang),y+r1*math.sin(ang),x+r2*math.cos(ang),y+r2*math.sin(ang),c=INK,w=1.8)
  self.oval(x-.10*s,y-.10*s,.20*s,.20*s,fill=YEL,stroke=None)
 def check(self,x,y,s=1,c=INK):
  self.line(x,y+.06*s,x+.09*s,y+.15*s,c=c,w=2.2)
  self.line(x+.09*s,y+.15*s,x+.26*s,y-.04*s,c=c,w=2.2)
 def folder(self,x,y,w=.65,h=.45,label=''):
  self.rect(x,y,w,h,fill=WHITE,stroke=INK,sw=1.6,radius=True)
  self.rect(x+.06,y-.085,w*.38,.12,fill=PAL,stroke=INK,sw=1)
  if label:self.txt(label,x+.04,y+.15,w-.08,.15,font=8.5)

def draw_scene(s,idx,variant):
 d=Draw(s)
 # tiny yellow top-of-scene motif
 d.rect(0.05,.03,.60,.06,fill=YEL,stroke=None)
 # scenes in a roughly 2.7 x 3.8 inch patch
 if idx==1:
  # outlined sandbox and unexpected exit; one human reacts
  d.rect(.16,.64,1.48,2.32,fill=WHITE,stroke=MUTED,sw=1.7,radius=True)
  d.txt('SANDBOX',.30,.81,1.20,.26,10)
  d.line(.22,2.69,1.58,2.69,c=MUTED,w=1.4,dashed=True)
  d.robot(1.86,1.45,.83,pose='build');d.arrow(1.30,1.79,1.63,1.62,c=INK)
  d.person(.63,1.55,.72,pose='shock')
  d.spark(2.32,.80,.75)
  d.txt('?',2.26,.25,.32,.45,25)
 elif idx==2:
  d.rect(.25,.60,2.22,1.15,fill=WHITE,stroke=INK,sw=1.5,radius=True)
  d.txt('RUN HISTORY',.4,.75,1.85,.23,font=12)
  for j in range(4):
   d.line(.49,1.20+j*.15,1.75,1.20+j*.15,c=MUTED,w=1.15)
   d.check(1.98,1.15+j*.15,.55)
  d.rect(1.52,2.34,.99,.59,fill=PAL,stroke=INK,sw=1.4,radius=True)

import os
from PIL import Image,ImageOps,ImageDraw,ImageFont
from pathlib import Path
from pdf2image import convert_from_path
base=Path("/mnt/data/stick_figure_editorial")
styles=[("Folio Magazine","A_Folio_Magazine"),("Swiss Grid","B_Swiss_Grid"),("Investigative Dossier","C_Investigative_Dossier"),("Studio Type","D_Studio_Type")]
# construct comparison preview pdf from the real pptx rendering, not imagegen
import fitz
pdf=fitz.open()
for label,stem in styles:
    p=fitz.open(str(base/"pdf"/f"{stem}_WITH_STICK_FIGURES.pdf"))
    page=pdf.new_page(width=1440,height=1000)
    page.insert_text((54,48), f"{label} - 8 editable slides", fontsize=29, fontname="helv", color=(0.12,0.12,0.12))
    # 8 slide thumbnails arranged 4 columns x 2 rows
    gap=20
    w=250
    h=w*10/8
    left=(1440-(4*w+3*gap))/2
    top=90
    for i in range(8):
        cx=i%4; cy=i//4
        dest=fitz.Rect(left+cx*(w+gap),top+cy*(h+37),left+cx*(w+gap)+w,top+cy*(h+37)+h)
        page.show_pdf_page(dest,p,i)
        page.insert_text((dest.x0+4,dest.y1+17),f"{i+1:02}",fontsize=13,color=(0.3,0.3,0.3))
    p.close()
dst=base/"ALL_STYLES_COMPARISON_PREVIEW.pdf"
pdf.save(str(dst),garbage=4,deflate=True);pdf.close()
print(dst, os.stat(dst).st_size)
